yad rujānirapekṣasya cchidyamānasya te ’sakṛt | vadhakeṣv api sattveṣv kāruṇyam abhavat prabho
sa āryeṇoktaḥ | śroṇa tāṃ tāvat pūrvikāṃ pratijñāṃ paripūraya yathāgṛhītān sandeśān samarpayeti |
asyā hy abhyudayāl loke sarvadravyāṇy aśeṣataḥ | malinānīva jātāni śuklāni rucirāṇi ca
ānaya me pātram iti |
uttarottarataḥ śreṣṭhā dānapāramitādayaḥ | netarārthaṃ tyajec chreṣṭhām anyatrācārasetutaḥ
sādhu sādhu, kulaputra, subhāṣitas tvayāyaṃ dharmaparyāyas, tvayā tathāgato ’numodate!yā tvayā madanumodanā gaṅgānadīvālukāsamā buddhā bhagavanto ’pi tayānumodate.
nava pramodyapūrvakā dhasmāḥ
ādimadhyāvasānāni cintyāni kṣaṇavat punaḥ | ādimadhyāvasānatvaṃ na svataḥ parato ’pi vā
tantrajālajātaḥ / tantrajālajātāḥ
teṣāṃ atha pramāṇair vinā prasiddhir vihīyate vādaḥ | vaiṣamikatvaṃ tasmin viśeṣahetuś ca vaktavyaḥ
sarvāvatī sā parṣad akṣayamater bodhisattvasya sumahāprāmodyaprītimānanām utpādyedaṃ vacanam avocat:
atha viśākhā mṛgāramātā utthāyāsanād yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantam idam avocat |
kiṃ cānyat | nāmāsad iti ca yad idaṃ tat kiṃ nu sato bhavaty utāpy asataḥ | yadi hi sato yady asato dvidhāpi te hīyate vādaḥ
upadruto ’yaṃ kāyaś caturuttaraiś caturbhī rogaśataiḥ |

atha mā bhūd eṣa doṣa iti kṛtvā naiva grāho ’sti naiva grāhyaṃ na ca grahītāra ity evaṃ sati grāhasya yaḥ pratiṣedho niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarvabhāvā iti so ’pi nāsti, pratiṣedhyam api nāsti, pratiṣeddhāro ’pi na santi |
sa bhikṣur yasya śīlāni sa dhyāyī yatra śunyatā | sa tu bhikṣur idaṃ jahāty apāraṃ hy urago jīrṇam iva tvacaṃ purāṇam
yathā bimbaṃ bhūṣāprakṛtiguṇavad darpaṇagataṃ viśiṣṭaṃ prāmodyaṃ janayati nṛṇāṃ darśanavaśāt | tathā dharmaḥ soktaprakṛtiguṇayukto ’pi satataṃ vibhaktārthas tuṣṭiṃ janayati viśiṣṭām iha satām
bālānām arhatām ebhiḥ śaikṣāṇāṃ dhīmatāṃ kramāt | malaiś caturbhir ekena dvābhyāṃ dvābhyām aśuddhatā
viruddhapratyayotpattau duḥkhasyānudayo yadi | kalpanābhiniveśo hi vedanety āgataṃ nanu
tato ’sau brāhmaṇas tatpracārāvarjitajanitasaumanasyo balamitrasya gṛhapater niveśanaṃ praviśya kanyāpratilambhatṛṣṇāyā sasaṃbhramaḥ svasti svastīty uvāca |
gatyā yayājyate gantā gatiṃ tāṃ sa na gacchati | yasmān na gatipūrvo ’sti kaścid kiṃcid dhi gacchati
kiṃ cānyat | atha nāsti sa svabhāvaḥ kiṃ nu pratiṣidhyate tvayānena | vacanena rte vacanāt pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyate hy asataḥ
sa kathayati | saṃnipatitād eva ayam ādīnavaḥ prādurbhūto nāhaṃ saṃnipatāmīti |
sa rājasūnur mṛgarājagāmī mṛgājiraṃ tan mṛgavat praviṣṭaḥ | lakṣmīviyukto ’pi śarīralakṣmyā cakṣūṃṣi sarvāśramiṇāṃ jahāra
madhye kalyāṇam
evaṃ sa tais tair viṣayopacārair vayoanurūpair upacaryamāṇaḥ | bālo ’py abālapratimo babhūva dhṛtyā ca śaucena dhiyā śriyā ca

anena caturthena tatsvabhāvasya buddhatvasya sarvagatatvaṃ darśayati | ākāśasādharmyeṇoddeśanirdeśataḥ pūrvāparārdhābhyāṃ | satvagaṇeṣu sarvagatatvaṃ buddhatvasyātmatvena sarvasatvopagamane pariniṣpattito veditavyaṃ |
puram atha purataḥ praveśya patnīṃ sthavirajanānugatām apatyanāthām | nṛpatir api jagāma paurasaṃghair divam amarair maghavān ivārcyamānaḥ
parikalpasamucchṛtaḥ (parikalpasamupasthitaḥ)
tataḥ paścān mahatī sīmā baddhavyā |
evaṃ ta mūlamapahāya ajānamāno śākhāpalāśa parieṣayiṣyanti mūḍhāḥ | hastiṃ labhitva yatha hastipadaṃ gaveṣe tatha prajñapāramita śrutva sūtrānta eṣet
tatra katamā bodhisattvasya pūrvanivāsānusmṛtijñānasākṣātkaraṇābhijñā?
nānāstīrṇapṛthivīpradeśe pātraṃ sthāpayiṣyāmaḥ
atha ratnaduṣyāṇi ratnacchattrāṇi ratnapatākā ratnadāmakā ratnajaṭāmāṃsayo ratnaracitapaṭṭadāmāno daśabhyo digbhya āgacchanto dṛśyante.
bauddhair dharmair yac ca susaṃpūrṇaśarīraṃ yat saddharme vetti sa satvān pravinetum | yātaṃ pāraṃ yatkṛpayā sarvajagatsu tad buddhatvaṃ śreṣṭham iha eṣyaṃ śaraṇānām
yasya jitaṃ nopajīyate jitam anveti na kaṃcid eva loke | taṃ buddham anantagocaraṃ hy apadaṃ kena padena neṣyasi
anena ślokena caturthena viśuddhyupāyaṃ karmaṇo darśayati | maṇḍalapariśuddhitaḥ kartṛkarmakriyāṇām anupalambhāt | anantam ity akṣayaṃ |
evaṃ pravṛttān bhavataḥ śaraṇyān atīva saṃdarśitapakṣapātān | yāsyāmi hitveti mamāpi duḥkhaṃ yathaiva bandhūṃs tyajatas tathaiva
varṇārhavarṇe buddhastotre brahmānuvādo nāma saptamaḥ paricchedaḥ
tataḥ paścān naivāsikā bhikṣavaḥ sanniṣaṇṇāḥ sannipatitā āgacchaṃty alpatarakās. taiḥ punar api jñaptiṃ kṛtvā pravārayitavyaṃ. pūrvikā bhikṣavaḥ sātisārāḥ kalpasāmantakāḥ.

tatra vyavahārasatyaṃ yā kāle satyavāditā yad idaṃ duḥkhasatyaṃ samudayasatyaṃ nirodhasatyaṃ mārgasatyaṃ;lokavyavahārasatyaṃ yāvad akṣaraśabdasaṃketanirdiṣṭam.paramārthasatyaṃ yad idam asaṃmoṣadharma nirvāṇam.tat kasya hetoḥ?nityadharmatathatātvāt,tadgotranityatvāt.
vaiśālyām anyatamaḥ puruṣaḥ | tasya śatapadī karṇaṃ praviṣṭā |sā tatra prasutā | saptaśatāny apatyānāṃ jātāni |sa karṇaśūlābhyāhato jīvakasya sakāśaṃ gataḥ | cikitsāṃ kuruṣveti |
sa mām evam āha:
vijñāpayāmi saṃbuddhān sarvadikṣu vyavasthitān | mahākāruṇikāṃś cāpi bodhisattvān kṛtāñjaliḥ
nandopanandau nāgarājānau
so ’ham avocam no hīdaṃ kulaputra |
śataṃ hetvindriyāṇāṃ samāptalambho nāmocyate
mahatsv api hi kṛcchreṣu na rasaṃ cakṣur īkṣate | evaṃ kṛcchram api prāpya na kleśavaśago bhavet
dvādasāṅgabhāvaparīkṣā nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamaṃ prakaraṇaṃ ||
ahasaṃjñatastu mamatā bhavate ca rāgo kutu tyāgabuddhi bhaviṣyati sā muhānām | mātsarya preta bhavate upapadyayātī athavā manuṣya tada bhoti daridrarūpo
amedhyapuñje pracchanne tatkledārdreṇa carmaṇā | yaḥ śayīta sa nārīṇāṃ śayīta jaghanodare
dhanyam asmīti te rūpaṃ vadatīvāśritān guṇān | sunikṣiptā vayam iti pratyāhur iva tad guṇāḥ

sudatto ’py āha: nāhaṃ bhagavan utsahe tasya satpuruṣasya glānaparipṛcchako gantum |tat kasmād dhetoḥ |abhijānāmy ahaṃ bhagavan: svake paitṛke niveśane mahāyajñaṃ yajāmi |sarvadaridraduḥkhitebhyaḥ sarvaśramaṇabrāhmaṇakṛpaṇavanīyakayācanakebhyo dānaṃ dadāmi |saptadivasān mahāyajñaṃ yajāmi |
kāścit kanakakāñcībhir mukharābhir itas tataḥ | babhramur darśayantyo ’sya śroṇīs tanvaṃśukāvṛtāḥ
uddhatasya pramattasya bhikṣuṇo bahir ātmanaḥ | śīlaṃ samādhiḥ prajñā ca pāripūriṃ na gacchati
divākarāyate bhūyo ’py ajñānatimiraṃ nudat | śakrāyudhāyate mānagirīn abhividārayat
dharmāṇāṃ pramukhaṃ teṣu vidyate trividhaś ca saḥ | dhyānam evaṃ parijñāya paṇḍitaḥ samudānayet
na ca kalpavikalpaparikalpanimittārambaṇadṛṣṭaśrutamatavijñaptaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃvasati, yāvan na sarvagranthasamāropaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃvasati.

bhagavān āha | evaṃ subhūte bodhisatvayānasaṃprasthitena sarvadharmā jñatavyā adhimoktavyās tathā cādhimoktavyā yathā na dharmasaṃjñāpi pratyupatiṣṭhettat kasya hetoḥ dharmasaṃjñā dharmasaṃjñeti subhūte asaṃjñaiṣā tathāgatena bhāṣitā tenocyate dharmasaṃjñeti |
dīrghikāṃ prāvṛtāṃ paśya tīrajaiḥ sinduvārakaiḥ | pāṇḍurāṃśukasaṃvītāṃ śayānāṃ pramadām iva
apareṇa samayena te rathābhirūḍhā bahir nirgatāḥ praviśanti |purohitaputraś ca rathābhirūḍho nirgacchati |yāvad anyonyadhurātuṇḍo lagnaḥ |purohitaputraḥ kathayati | apanayateti |
jhallarī (ṛllarī)
vṛthaivāyur vahaty āśu vivekas tu sudurlabhaḥ | tatrāpy abhyastavikṣepanivāraṇagatiḥ kutaḥ
sthāpanā bhājanatve ca śīleṣv eva ca ropaṇaṃ | marṣaṇā cāpakārasya arthe vyāpāragāmitā
tataḥ paścād bhikṣubhir āvāsaṃ gocaraṃ cāvalokayitvā channe praviśya varṣā upagantavyaṃ.
yady ubhayavyañjanā bhavanti | kiṃ punar ubhayavyañjanā apy upapādukā bhavanti |bhavanty apāyeṣuevaṃ tāvat kāmadhātau | atha rūpadhātāv ārūpyadhātau ca katham ity āha |
nādhīravat kāmasukhe sasañje na saṃrarañje viṣamaṃ jananyām | dhṛtyendriyāśvāṃś capalān vijigye bandhūṃś ca paurāṃś ca guṇair jigāya
na sakthani sakthyādhāya
kliṣṭe traidhātuke lābhaḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ dvayoḥ
yan mayāryamahākātyāyanaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādya praṇīte ' trayastriṃśe devanikāye upapattavyaṃ sāhaṃ mithyāpraṇidhānaṃ kṛtvā pretamaharddhikā saṃvṛttā |
svam ātmānaṃ darśanaṃ hi tat tam eva na paśyati | na paśyati yad ātmānaṃ kathaṃ drakṣyati tat parān
na sāmiṣam udakam antargṛhe chorayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
santi bhadanta bhagavataḥ śrāvakā bahvābādhāḥ svalpābādhāś ca |tatra ye bahvābādhās teṣāṃ kṛtam eva tāvat | ye tv alpābādhās te paribhujya bhūyasyā mātrayā sukhasparśaṃ vihariṣyanti |
paralokāt tvayā rājyaṃ nānītaṃ nāpi neṣyasi | dharmāt prāptam ato ’syārthe nādharmaṃ kartum arhasi
khedo yenābhīkṣṇaṃ na deśayet | matsaritvaṃ cākṛtsnaprakāśantā | arthasaṃpattau ślokadvayaṃ |

tena khalu samayenāyuṣmān ānando bhagavataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sthito ’bhūd vyajanaṃ gṛhītvā bhagavantaṃ vījayan | tatra bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam āmantrayate | gṛhāṇānanda śatasahasramūlyaṃ bṛhatikāprāvaraṇaṃ mamārthāya śastralūnaṃ kuruṣveti |
ātmānaṃ cet priyaṃ vidyād rakṣed enaṃ surakṣitam | yathā pratyantanagaraṃ gambhīraparikhaṃ dṛḍham | trayāṇām anyatamaṃ yāmaṃ pratijāgreta paṇḍitaḥ
bhikṣavaḥ saṃśayajātāḥ sarvasaṃśayacchettāraṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ papracchuḥ | paśya bhadantāyuṣmān upanandaḥ atilobhena vipannaḥ |
upaśāntasya gāmbhīryaṃ gāmbhīryād gauravaṃ param | gauravād dīptir ājñā ca tasmād upaśamaṃ bhaja
naiva cāvyākṛtatve ’pi deśanā ’prāptaye matā | dharmaratnaṃ tataś caikaṃ ratnād anyād viśiṣyate ||
evam eva vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskāravijñānāni ||
duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasamutpādaṃ duḥkhasya samatikramam | āryāṣṭāṅgikaṃ mārgaṃ kṣemaṃ nirvāṇagāminam
yāvanti loki parikīrtita dharmanāma sarveṣu pādasamatikramu nirgamitvā | amṛtaṃ ti jñānu paramaṃ na tu yo pareṇa ekārtha prajña ayu pāramiteti nāmā
vikṣepacittaṃ ca vivarjayantān ekāgracittān vanakandareṣu | dhyāyanta varṣāṇa sahasrakoṭyo dhyānena te prasthita agrabodhim
dvābhyāṃ saṃjñābhyāṃ avicalanāt nimittasaṃjñayā animittābhogasaṃjñayā ca |
atha khalv āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam idam avocat:ko nāmāyaṃ, bhagavan, dharmaparyāyam, kathaṃ cainaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi?
tasmād āvaraṇaṃ hantuṃ samādhānaṃ karomy aham | vimārgāc cittam ākṛṣya svālambananirantaram

te kathayanti | bhavanto yadi vayaṃ nivartiṣyāmaḥ sarva evānayena vyasanam āpatsyāmaḥ | āgacchata kriyākāraṃ tāvat kurmaḥ | tāvan na kenacic chroṇasya koṭīkarṇasya mātāpitṛbhyām ārocayitavyaṃ yāvad bhāṇḍaṃ na pratiśāmitaṃ bhavatīti | te kriyākāraṃ kṛtvā gatāḥ |

yathā tasmin na tadbhāvo māyākṛte hastitvādyabhāvas tathā tasmin paratantre paramārtha iṣyate parikalpitasya dvayalakṣaṇasyābhāvaḥ | yathā tasya māyākṛtasya hastyādibhāvenopalabdhis tathābhūtaparikalpasya saṃvṛtisatyatopalabdhiḥ |
bhavati tathāgataḥ paraṃ maraṇāt
tribhir ghrāṇādibhis tulyaviṣayagrahaṇaṃ matam |
upanaro nāgarājā
saṃbhārāṃś ca sa bodheḥ kṣipraṃ pūrayati lajjayā dhīmān |
tadvad utpādayāmy eṣa bodhicittaṃ jagaddhite | tadvad eva ca tāḥ śikṣāḥ śikṣiṣyāmi yathā kramam
kalpitaṃ bhāvam aspṛṣṭvā tadabhāvo na gṛhyate | tasmād bhāvo mṛṣā yo hi tasyābhāvaḥ sphuṭaṃ mṛṣā
yady asty eva pratīkāro daurmanasyena tatra kim | atha nāsti pratīkāro daurmanasyena tatra kim
kākacañcukam (kāṃkacañcukam)
na muṇḍitena śramaṇo na bhoḥ kāreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ | yas tu vāhayate pāpāny aṇu sthūlāni sarvaśaḥ | vāhitatvāt tu pāpānāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śramaṇaḥ sa ca
anayāvidyayā bālaḥ saṃyuktaḥ pañcaparvayā | saṃsāre duḥkhabhūyiṣṭhe janmasv abhiniṣicyate
ity etad adhipatiphalaṃ |
anāsvādaḥ sukhe caiva nimittānāmakalpanā | sātatyakaraṇīyaṃ hi dhīmatāṃ sarvabhūmiṣu
snātvā snātvā yathā kaścid viśed vahniṃ muhur muhuḥ | svasausthityaṃ ca manyanta evam apy atiduḥsthitāḥ
anavasthitacittasya saddharmam avijānataḥ | pāriplavaprasādasya prajñā na paripūryate
parvato ’pi suvarṇasya samo himavatā bhavet | vittaṃ taṃ nālam ekasyaitaj jñātvā samaṃ caret
dhātavaḥ sapta ca matāḥ
jñātvā ca dharmaprakṛtīṃ vaśikā nirātmyaṃ ātmāna māṃsa tyajamānu adīnacitto | prāgeva vastu tada bāhira nātyajeyā asthānameta yadi matsari so kareyā
ārṣaś ca deśanādharmo artho ’bhiprāyiko ’sya ca | prāmāṇikaś ca nītārtho nirjalpā prāptir asya ca
adyaiva śaraṇaṃ yāmi jagannāthān mahābalān | jagadrakṣārtham udyuktān sarvatrāsaharān jinān
nāsadbhūto ’pi sadbhūtaṃ sadasadbhūtam eva vā | karoti kārakaḥ karma pūrvoktair eva hetubhiḥ

brahmāpi sahāpatiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmakāyikair devaputrair bhagavantam etad avocat aham api bhagavaṃs tasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhitur vā rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ saṃvidhāsyāmi, ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitām udgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati ||
sa taṃ paṭakam ādāya prakrāntaḥ |

yaḥ punar bhikṣur dviṣṭoddeśād apratītaḥ śuddhaṃ bhikṣuṃ amūlakena pārājikena dharmeṇānudhvaṃsayed apy evainaṃ brahmacaryāc cyāvayeyam iti tasya ca apareṇa samayena samanuyujyamāno vā asamanuyujyamāno vā amūlakam eva svādhikaraṇaṃ bhaved bhikṣuś ca dveṣe pratiṣṭhed dveṣeṇāvocam iti saṃghāvaśeṣaḥ |

punar yāvantaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ kleśā vikṣiptacittāni ca tāvān bodhisattvānāṃ dhyānasaṃbhāraś cittasthāpanājñānaṃ ca;yāvantaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ kleśā vikṣiptacittāni ca tāvad bodhisattvānāṃ dhyānasaṃbhārasamudānayanam.
teṣāṃ viśuddhaśīlānām apramādavihāriṇām | samyag ājñā vimuktānāṃ māro mārgaṃ na vindati
tataś ca bodhipakṣāṇāṃ saṃsāre pariṇāmanā | vinā ca cittasaṃkleśaṃ satvānāṃ paripācanā
tataḥ śrutvā rājā viṣayavimukhaṃ tasya tu mano na śiśye tāṃ rātriṃ hṛdayagataśalyo gaja iva | atha śrānto mantre bahuvividhamārge sasacivo na so ’nyat kāmebhyo niyamanam apaśyat sutamateḥ

ābhiś catasṛbhir atṛptibhir bodhisattvānāṃ jñānasaṃbhāra upacīyate. katamābhiś catasṛbhis?tad yathā śrutātṛptir;nirdeśātṛptir;vicārātṛptir;jñānātṛptiḥ.ābhiś catasṛbhir atṛptibhir bodhisattvānāṃ jñānasaṃbhāra upacīyate.
tricīvaraṃ mayā mohapuruṣa samanujñātam | kasmāt tvaṃ sāntarottareṇa yāpayasi | tasmān na bhikṣuṇā sāntarottareṇa cīvareṇa yāpayitavyam | yāpayati | sātisāro bhavati |
bhadro ’pi paśyate pāpaṃ yāvad bhadraṃ na pacyate | yadā tu pacyate bhadram atha bhadrāṇi paśyati
triṣu dhātuṣu kuśalaṃ cittaṃ dvidhā bhidyate | prāyogikaṃ copapattilābhikaṃ ca
sacet pārājikāṃ pratijānāti | nāśayitvā pravārayitavyaṃ.
tau bhikṣubhir ucyete | āyuṣmantau yuvayor upādhyāyena tasya gṛhapateḥ sakāśāt paṃca paṭaśatāni labdhāni | tāny asmābhir eva bhājitāni | adhunāpy eṣa lābho ’smākam eva prāpadyate |

putri śobhanam etad api gatam |idam aparaṃ pṛcchāmi | etā dārikā vātavarṣe devakulaṃ praviṣṭās tvaṃ punar abhyavakāśe sthitā |
asya rūpaṃ tu kāyasyobhe ca sarvataḥ
tūṣṇīṃbhāvānukūlāpi vaktum apy akilāsinī | ubhayor dharmayor ekā sabhāgā visabhāgayoḥ
yuvāṃ pratyavāyabhīrūkau kim icchathaḥ |

pañcendriyāṇi cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇajihvākāyendriyāṇi |pañcārthās teṣām eva cakṣurādīnām indriyāṇāṃ yathāsvaṃ ye pañca viṣayāḥ rūpaśabdagandharasaspraṣṭavyākhyāḥ |avijñaptiś ceti |etāvān rūpaskandhaḥtatra ya ete pañca rūpādayo ’rthā uktāḥ |
atra punar jātidravyaṃ gṛhyate | bhūtacatuṣkāntarāṇāṃ svajātyanatikramāt |kaḥ punar yat sa evaṃ vikalpena vaktum |cchandato ’pi hi vācāṃ pravṛttir arthas tu parīkṣyaḥ |
sa tathā samāhitacittaḥ pariśuddhaḥ paryavadāto naṃgaṇo vigatopakleśaḥ samādhiṃ ca na riṃcati dhyānakarma ca karoti II
āstāṃ tāvat paro loko dṛṣṭo ’py artho na sidhyati | bhṛtyasyākurvataḥ karma svāmino ’dadato bhṛtim
kuhanā lābhasatkārahetor indriyasaṃvaraḥ | lapanā lābhasatkārahetoś cāṭupuraskriyā
bhaiṣajyāñjananālikā (bhaiṣajyajānanālika, bhaiṣajyāñcananālikā)

ākāśa dṛṣṭu iti sattva pravyāharanti nabhadarśanaṃ kutu vimṛṣyatha etam artham | tatha dharmadarśanu nidiṣṭa tathāgatena na hi darśanaṃ bhaṇitu śakya nidarśanena
adattādānād viratiḥ

yatha istri gurviṇi ya ceṣṭati vedanābhi jñātavyu kālu ayamasya prajāyanāya | tatha bodhisattva śruṇamāṇu jināna prajñāṃ rati chanda vīkṣati spṛśiṣyati bodhi śīghram
śrīvardhanaḥ kathayati | kiṃ prārthayase |

kutaḥ sukhaṃ vā duḥkhaṃ vā kiṃ priyaṃ vā kim apriyam | kā tṛṣṇā kutra sā tṛṣṇā mṛgyamāṇā svabhāvataḥ
janānurūpāviparītadeśanā nirunnatā cāpy amamā vicakṣaṇā | kṣamā ca dāntā ca sudūragā ’kṣayā jinātmajānāṃ pratipattir uttamā
sa kathayati | satyam etad api tu yasya tvayopadeśaḥ kṛtas tena mamopadiṣṭam |
yathaivādityaraśmīnāṃ meghādyāvaraṇaṃ matam | tathaiva buddhajñānānām āvṛtiḥ satvaduṣṭatā

tena tatra praviśya pānīyaṃ pānīyam iti śabdaḥ kṛtaḥ | anekaiḥ pretasahasrair dagdhasthūṇākṛtibhir ' asthiyantravad ucchritaiḥ svakeśaromapraticchannaiḥ parvatasannibhodaraiḥ sūcīcchidropamamukhair anuparivāritaḥ | te kathayanti |
śikṣayopāsānāt pūrvaṃ kuśalasyāvaropaṇāt | śīlavanto ’nyabuddheṣu guṇavantaś ca kīrtitāḥ ||

sphuṭam (sphaṭam)

ākāśāsaṅgavimuktinirupalepo nāma samādhiḥ

duṣpravrajyaṃ durabhiramaṃ duradhyāvasitā gṛhāḥ | duhkhāsamānasaṃvāsā duhkhāś copacitā bhavāḥ
svayam apagataśokā dehinaḥ svastharūpā vipulam api gṛhītvā bhuñjate yasya vittaṃ | pathi paramaphalāḍhyād bhogavṛkṣād yathaiva pravisṛtir atibhogī bodhisatvān na so ’nyaḥ
emeva prajñacarito vidu bodhisattvo amṛtasya dāyaku priyo marumānuṣāṇām | ayu eṣa eṣati hi sattvasukhābhiyukto prāgeva yāva sthitu bheṣyati dharmarājo
bodhicaryānurūpyeṇa jinastambho ’pi sādhitaḥ | karoti sarvakāryāṇi bodhisattve ’pi nirvṛte
manaś ca yo rakṣati bhāṣitaṃ ca ceṣṭe ca kāyasya sadaiva yuktaḥ | sa prāpya śokaṃ hi na duhkhitaḥ syāt satyasthitaḥ satyavidaḥ sumedhāḥ
|| brāhmaṇavargaḥ
upanandaḥ saṃlakṣayati | saced adyaiva pāsyāmi adyaiva svastho bhaviṣyāmi | śvaḥ katareṇa kalpena ghṛtaṃ samādhāpayiṣyāmi vastrāṇi vā | yāvad iṣṭaṃ kalpaṃ samādhāpayiṣyāmi tāvat paścāt pāsyāmīti |
katame haimavatā janapadāḥ | yatrodakasthālakaṃ śyāyati |

kṣāntaṃ buddhasutaiḥ suduṣkaramatho sarvāpakāraṃ nṛṇāṃ na svargārtham asaśaktimato na ca bhayān naivopakārekṣaṇāt | kṣāntyānuttarayā ca sarvajanatā bodhitraye ropitā kṣāntir jñānaparigraheṇa ca punar loke ’kṣayā sthāpitā
varam adyaiva me mṛtyur na mithyājīvitaṃ ciram | yasmāc ciram api sthitvā mṛtyuduḥkhaṃ tadaiva me
vicitralokasaṃpattivipākaḥ sumahānn api | karmāṇi etāni dharme pratipatter matāni x ||
na tat karma kṛtaṃ sādhu yat kṛtvā hy anutapyate | rudann aśru mukho yasya vipākaṃ pratiṣevate

anutpannānāṃ pāpakānām akuśalānaṃ dharmāṇām anutpādāya cchandaṃ janayatīdaṃ yoniśomanasikārasyādhivacanam.vyāyacchate vīryam ārabhata itīdaṃ yoniśomanasikārānutsargasyādhivacanam.cittaṃ pragṛhṇāti samyak pradadhātītīdaṃ yoniśaḥ pratyavekṣaṇatāyā adhivacanam.
sa saṃlakṣayati | nūnaṃ devīyaṃ vā nāgī vā yakṣī vā bhaviṣyati | sa kathayati | ārye tṛṣito ’smi bubhukṣito ’smi |
sa tena pravrājita upasaṃpādito
asya khalu sūtrasthānīyasya ślokasya yathākramaṃ pariśiṣṭena granthena vistara vibhāganirdeśo veditavyaḥ | śakrapratibhāsatvād iti |
ime khalv āyuṣmantaḥ saptādhikaraṇaśamathāḥ dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti |
idaṃ vicāryate |yaś cakṣurdhātunā ’samanvāgataḥ samanvāgamaṃ pratilabhate cakṣurvijñānadhātunā ’pi saḥ |yo vā cakṣurvijñānadhātunā cakṣurdhātunā ’pi saḥ | āha |

śaṅkhasvarasamācaraḥ (śaṅkhasvarasamāccharaḥ)
uddānam | svabhāvahetuphalataḥ karmayogapravṛttitaḥ | tannityācintyataś caiva buddhabhūmiṣv avasthitaḥ
yasmin na prajñavarapāramitopalabdhiḥ na ca bodhisattvaupalabdhi na cittabodheḥ | evaṃ śruṇitva na ca muhyati nāsti trāso so bodhisattva carate sugatāna prajñām
atha khalu dharmadhātupraṇidhisunirmitacandrarājo bodhisattvo buddhadhiṣṭhānena daśa diśo vyavalokya tasyāṃ velāyām imā gāthā abhāṣata
te tatra na māpayanti |bhagavān āha | upariṣṭād dvitīyaṃ puraṃ kartavyaṃ |
evaṃ cittaṃ yadā saṅgād dahyate dveṣavahninā | tatkṣaṇaṃ tatparityājyaṃ puṇyātmoddāhaśaṅkayā
dākṣiṇyam auṣadhaṃ strīṇāṃ dākṣiṇyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ param | dākṣiṇyarahitaṃ rūpaṃ niṣpuṣpam iva kānanam
punar aparaṃ, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, bodhisattvānāṃ mārgo ’py akṣayaḥ.
yasya dharmaṃ vijānīyād vṛddhasya daharasya vā | satkṛtyainaṃ namasyeta hy agni hotram iva dvijaḥ
tatra katamat samādhīndriyam?
dānataś ca jñānasaṃbhāro draṣṭavya, evaṃ śīlakṣāntivīryadhyānaprajñātaś ca jñānasaṃbhāro draṣṭavyaḥ;maitrīkaruṇāmuditopekṣātaś ca jñānasaṃbhāro draṣṭavyaḥ.
na ca kāmakalahāvilaskandhakleśamṛtyudevaputramāraiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃvasati, yāvan na sarvamārakarmabhiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃvasati.
sakalaṃ vipulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ satataṃ muditaṃ nirāmiṣaṃ śuddhaṃ | bodhinataṃ kuśalanataṃ jinātmajānāṃ kṛṣādānam
tau nyāyatas taṃ pratipūjya vipraṃ tenārcitau tāv api cānurūpam | kṛtāsanau bhārgavam āsanasthaṃ chittvā kathām ūcatur ātmakṛtyam
tṛṇaprastārakaḥ (stṛṇāprastārakaḥ)

punar aparaṃ catvāro ’kṣayāḥ prayogāḥ. katame catvāraḥ? saṃkleśahetugatiprayogākṣayatā vyavadānahetugatiprayogākṣayatā saṃkleśahetuparikīrtanaprayogākṣayatā vyavadānaguṇānuśaṃsaparikīrtanaprayogākṣayatā, ime catvāro ’kṣayāḥ prayogāḥ;
kiṃ dhīrā vivadiṣyanti tvādṛśā jitakāśinaḥ | ko vivādaḥ sahasrāṃśoḥ śavena tamasā saha
abhūtakalpo na bhūto nābhūto ’kalpa eva ca | na kalpo nāpi cākalpaḥ sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ nirucyate

yadi ca prameyaiḥ pramāṇāni sidhyanti tāni ca prameyāṇitair eva pramāṇaiḥ sādhayitavyāni nanv asiddheṣu pramāṇeṣu kāraṇasyāsiddhatvād siddhāni kathaṃ sādhayiṣyanti pramāṇāni |
prativarṇikāyāṃ varṇikābhūtāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ ca nārūciḥ | nādhivāsamanaskāro vyākṛtaniyate spṛhā

sacet subhūte teṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ vā puṇyaskandhaṃ bhāṣet | yāvaṃtaḥ te kulaputrā vā kuladuhitaro vā tasmin samaye puṇyaskandhaṃ pratigṛhṇaṃti | unmādaṃ te satvāḥ prāpnuyuḥ cittavikṣepaṃ vā gaccheyuḥ |api tu khalu punaḥ subhūte acintyo ’yaṃ dharmaparyāyaḥ asyācintya eva vipākaḥ ||

(ya)thā te svayam evātmā guṇair daśabalādibhiḥ | āviṣkṛtā karuṇayā tādṛśāya namo ’stu te

anāśvastān sattvān āśvāsayema
rājñaḥ prasenajitaḥ kosalasya baḍro nāma gavādhyakṣaḥ āyuṣmata upanandasya sapremakaḥ | sa tasya sakāśam upasaṃkrāntaḥ |
sa kathayati | ke yūyaṃ bhavantaḥ kena vā karmaṇā ihopapannāḥ | ta ūcuḥ | śroṇa duṣkuhakā jambudvīpakā manuṣyā nābhiśraddadhāsyanti | sa cāha | ahaṃ bhavantaḥ pratyakṣadarśī kasmān nābhiśraddadhāsye
tam eva śaraṇaṃ gantuṃ taṃ stotuṃ tam upāsitum | tasyaiva śāsane sthātuṃ nyāyyaṃ yady asti cetanā
tataḥ sa dhīro ’pi narendrasūnuḥ śrutvaiva mṛtyuṃ viṣasāda sadyaḥ | aṃsena saṃśliṣya ca kūbarāgraṃ provāca nihrādavatā svareṇa
ātmopakramaḥ (ātmopākrāmaḥ)
sukhabhogabubhukṣitasya vā janasārthasya bhavādhvacāriṇaḥ | sukhasattram idaṃ hy upasthitaṃ sakalābhyāgatasattvatarpaṇam

yena yena prakāreṇa cakṣurādīndriyagocare vicitre bodhisatvaḥ pravartate | īryāpathavyāpāracāre vartamānas tena tena prakāreṇa saṃbaddhasādṛśyavacanair hitārthaṃ satveṣu tat sarvam abhisaṃskaroti | yathā gocarapariśuddhisūtre vistareṇa nirdiṣṭaṃ | satveṣv akṣāntipratiṣedhe ślokaḥ |
śāstuḥ śāsanakaraḥ
duḥkhamahāugha ajñānamahāndhakāre ceti yojyaṃ | śeṣaṃ gatārthaṃ | kathaṃ lokātikrānta ityāha |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ayu pravucyati bodhisattvo sarvatra saṅgakriya icchati saṅgachedī | bodhiṃ spṛśiṣyati jināna asaṅgabhūtāṃ tasmāddhi nāma labhate ayu bodhisattvo
bhagavān āha | tīrthikadhvaja eṣa mohapuruṣaḥ yaduta nāgnyam |
saddharmaś ca cirasthitiko bhavati sma

ebhiś caturbhir mārgair bodhisattvānāṃ jñānasaṃbhāra upacīyate. katamaiś caturbhis?tad yathā pāramitāmārgo;bhūmimārgo;bodhipakṣikamārgaḥ;sarvajñajñānamārgaḥ.taiś caturbhiḥ mārgair bodhisattvānāṃ jñānasaṃbhāra upacīyate.
yad evāpadyate karma tat karma vyasanī bhavet | tat karmaśauṇḍo ’tṛptātmā krīḍāphalasukhepsuvat
yo bodhisattvaḥ samāpattau cittaṃ vajropamam adhitṣṭhaty ayaṃ tasyopāyaḥ; yaḥ prakṛtyavikṣiptatāṃ dhyāyatīyaṃ tasya prajñā.
imāṃ samudraparyantām adaṇḍena vasundharām | pālayiṣyati dharmeṇa samena sa narādhipaḥ
kiṃ cānyat | yadi ca prameyasiddhir nāpekṣyaiva bhavati pramāṇāni | kiṃ te pramāṇasiddhyā tani yad arthaṃ prasiddhaṃ tat
nirjivāḥ sarvadharmāḥ
etāni bodhisattvena tyājyāni yatinādhikam | doṣair etair vimukto hi guṇānāṃ sevate sukham
saprayatnasya vā punar asau prayatnaḥ svayaṃbhūr vā bhaved ākasmikaḥ | tatpratyayo

ye sattvā anantāparyanteṣu daśadiglokadhātuṣv ārūpyasattvān varjayitvā sarvagatiṣv upapannās, teṣām sarveṣāṃ cyutyupapattīr yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti, teṣāṃ karmahetūn yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti, teṣāṃ karmaphalānīndriyavaimātratāṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti.

sā tṛṣyate | tāṃ manuṣyo ’valokayan gacchati | tena bhikṣur dṛṣṭaḥ | āryeṇa kācit strī plavamānā dṛṣṭā | dṛṣṭā eṣā plavate | divase pānīyaṃ prativīkṣamāṇā tiṣṭhati evaṃ prāṇo ’syāyate | etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti |
noṣṇīṣaśirase āglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
puruṣā yathā mahaprapāti sthihitva kecid ubhi pāṇi chatradvaya gṛhṇa upakṣayeyyā | ākāli vāyur avasṛjya mahāprapāte no ca prapāta patiyāti na yāva tatra
tato rājñāmātyānām ājñā dattā gacchantu bhavantas sarvān etāṃ praghātayata |
paropaghātino doṣān parānugrahiṇo guṇān | jñātvocyate guṇadveṣī mahāyānasya nindakaḥ

anyatamena gṛhapatinā buddhapramukhā bhikṣusaṃghā antargṛhe nimaṃtritāḥ | sa uccāny āsanāni prajñapayitum ārabdhaḥ |

bahavas tṛṇaśayyāsu hitvā śayyāṃ hiraṇmayīm | aśerata sukhaṃ dhīrās tṛptā dharmarasasya te

atha tā apsaraso vimalakīrtiṃ namaskṛtyaivam āhuḥ:kathaṃ vayaṃ gṛhapate mārabhavane ’vatiṣṭhema |
vyavahāraṃ gṛhītvā, paramārthatas tatra yan na kaṃcit prahātavyaṃ dharmam upalabhate sarvadharmasamatāpratyakṣatayā, tenocyate samyakprahāṇam.
na daṇḍapāṇaye āglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
tadā hi tajjanmani tasya rājño manor ivādityasutasya rājye | cacāra harṣaḥ praṇanāśa pāpmā jajvāla dharmaḥ kaluṣaḥ śaśāma
bhikṣavaḥ kathayanty āyuṣmantaḥ īdṛśo ’py ayaṃ bhadrāśayo navapravrajita iti |
svadhātuto dvayābhāsāḥ sāvidyākleśavṛttayaḥ | vikalpāḥ saṃpravartante dvayadravyavivarjitāḥ

yadduḥkhajananaṃ vastu trāsas tasmāt prajāyatām | śūnyatā duḥkhaśamanī tataḥ kiṃ jāyate bhayam
sarveṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ sarvatra na vidyate svabhāvaś cet | tvadvacanam asvabhāvaṃ na nivartayituṃ svabhāvam alam
cittaṃ caittāḥ sahavaśyaṃ |
amātyaiḥ śrutam | khaṇḍo niṣpalāyatīti |
kāmaṃ param iti jñātvā devo ’pi hi puraṃdaraḥ | gautamasya muneḥ patnīm ahalyāṃ cakame purā

trayaṃ bodhisatvānāṃ sarvajanmasu vardhate karuṇāyogāt | karuṇā tadabhyāsāt | dānaṃ karuṇāvaśāt | bhogāś ca dānavaśāt | tasmāc ca trayāt phalaṃ trividhaṃ sukhaṃ bhavati | snehajanitaṃ karuṇātaḥ | satvānugrahajanitaṃ dānāt | tadanugrahakriyāśaktikṛtaṃ bhogebhyaḥ | dānaprotsāhanāyāṃ ślokaḥ |

trividhaṃ phalam asya prabhāvasya saṃdarśayati | ātmana āryādisukhavihāram atulyaṃ cotkṛṣṭaṃ ca lokadhātvantareṣu gatvā buddhānāṃ pūjanaṃ satvānāṃ viśodhanaṃ ca | karmārthaṃ ṣaḍvidham ārabhya catvāraḥ ślokāḥ | darśanakarma saṃdarśanakarma cārabhya ślokaḥ |

aho sthitir aho vṛttam aho rūpam aho guṇāḥ | na nāma buddhadharmāṇām asti kiṃ cid anadbhutam
tata āyuṣmatānandena rājñaḥ pratisandeśo bhagavate niveditaḥ | tatra bhagavān bhikṣūn āmantrayate sma |
prajñā vipakṣahīnā jñānena gatā ca nirvikalpena | sarvecchāparipūrā api satvavipācikā tredhā
ucchedaśāśvatāṃ dṛṣṭim akriyādṛṣṭiṃ ca āśritāḥ ' samyagdṛṣṭīya sthāpayiṣye tasmāt pravrājito hy ahaṃ ||

katham asādhāraṇatvam | na hi cakṣuranyasya vijñānasyāśrayībhavitum utsahate |rūpaṃ tu manovijñānasyālambanībhavaty anyacakṣurvijñānasyāpīti |evaṃ yāvat kāyo veditavyaḥ |tasmād āśrayabhāvād asādhāraṇatvāc ca vijñānaṃ tenaiva nirdiśyate na rūpādibhiḥ |yathā bherīśabdo yavāṅkura iti |
abhāginī yady aham āyatekṣaṇaṃ śucismitaṃ bhartur udīkṣituṃ mukham | na mandabhāgyo ’rhati rāhulo ’py ayaṃ kadācid aṅke parivartituṃ pituḥ
karoty anicchann īśaś cet parāyattaḥ prasajyate | icchann apīcchāyattaḥ syāt kurvataḥ kuta īśatā
siṃhavikrīḍito nāma samādhiḥ
yogaiḥ samuhyate bālo yogān nudati paṇḍitaḥ | yogān praṇudya medhāvī ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ
nāyudhapāṇaye dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāmaḥ
acalāditribhūmau ca vaśitā sā caturvidhā | dvidhaikasyāṃ tadanyasyām ekaikā vaśitā matā
na veṣṭitaśirase āglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |

yadā pakvaḥ tadā pracchannaṃ kṣureṇa spṛṣṭaḥ sphuṭitaḥ |tato rohiṇīyāni dravyāṇi dattāni |paṃca ghaṭaśatāni rohiṇīyair dravyair bhāvitāni |tad vraṇaṃ rūḍhaṃ samacchavi samaromaṃ saṃvṛttam |rājā snātamātraḥ kathayati | jīvaka cikitsāṃ kuruṣveti |

so ’nupūrveṇa vaiśālīṃ gataḥ |yāvan mallena mallasya talaprahāreṇākṣipelāko laṃbitaḥ |sa jīvakasya sakāśaṃ gataḥ |tena tasyāṃ pārṣṇyāṃ snāyujālam ākṛṣya praveśitam |tena tasya paṃca kārṣāpaṇaśatāni dattāni | tenābhayasya mātur dattāni |
alakṣaṇo na kaścic ca bhāvaḥ saṃvidyate kvacit | asaty alakṣaṇe bhāve kramatāṃ kuha lakṣaṇam
vyākṛtodbhavaḥ |
maraṇabhavasyopapattibhavasya cāntarā ya ātmabhāvo ’bhinirvarttate deśāntaropapattisamprāptaye so ’ntarābhava ity ucyate | gatyantarālatvāt |katham ayaṃ jātaś ca nāma na copapanno bhavati |
tac ca buddhanirmāṇaṃ sadā sarvathā cācintyaṃ veditavyaṃ | kṛtyakriyābhedataḥ saṃkhyātakṣetrataś ca |
vinā vā saha vā nāsti vibhavaḥ saṃbhavena vai | vinā vā saha vā nāsti saṃbhavo vibhavena vai
rūparatnātmabhāvāya cittaratnāntarātmane | dharmaratnākarāyāstu sarvaratnāya te namaḥ
daśa rupiṇo dhātavaḥ śeṣā nityam avitarkā avicārā asaṃprayogitvāt ||
yasya rāgaś ca doṣaś ca māno mrakṣaś ca śātitaḥ | na lipyate yaś ca doṣair bravīmi brāhmaṇaṃ hi tam
kim punaḥ kāraṇaṃ caitasikā ekatra saṃskāraskandhanikṣiptā vedanāsaṃjñe tu pṛthak skandhīkṛte ity āha
ūror yathaurvasya pṛthoś ca hastān māndhātur indrapratimasya mūrdhnaḥ | kakṣīvataś caiva bhujāṃsadeśāt tathāvidhaṃ tasya babhūva janma
tatrākāśam anāvṛtiḥ
na cāsau durbalenāptuṃ śakyam ity āgatādaraḥ | śarīrabalavṛddhyartham idaṃ bhūyo ’nvacintayat

punar aparaṃ catvāro ’kṣayāḥ prayogāḥ. katame catvāraḥ? araṇyavāsadhūtaguṇasaṃlekhānvayātṛptaprayogākṣayatā, puṇyajñānasaṃbhāropacayātṛptaprayogākṣayatā, śrutaparyeṣṭyatṛptaprayogākṣayatā, bodhipariṇāmanajñānātṛptaprayogākṣayatā, ime catvāro ’kṣayāḥ prayogāḥ;
phalaṃ sahaiva sāmagryā yadi prādurbhavet punaḥ | ekakālau prasajyete janako yaś ca janyate
sa cāha | bhoḥ puruṣa tvam evaṃ kathayasi | duṣkuhakā jambudvīpakā manuṣyā iti | nābhiśraddadhāsyati |
parikarmavastu (parikarmaṇavastu)
tad yathātmadṛṣṭiḥ sattvadṛṣtir jīvadṛṣtiḥ pudgaladṛṣtir ucchedadṛṣtiḥ śāśvatadṛṣṭir bhavadṛṣṭir vibhavadṛṣṭiḥ, ayam ucyate ’dharmaḥ.
viṣayaṃ viṣayaṃ prati vijñaptir upalabdhir skandha ity ucyate |sa punaḥ ṣaḍ vijñānakāyāḥ cakṣurvijñānaṃ yāvan manovijñānam iti |ya eṣa vijñānaskandha ukta āyatanavyavasthāyāṃ
anvavrajann āśramiṇas tatas taṃ tadrūpamāhātmyagatair manobhiḥ | deśād anāryair abhibhūyamānān maharṣayo dharmam ivāpayāntam
yā pūrvāntāparāntānusmṛtir iyam ucyate ’bhijñā; yat traikālyāsaktajñānam idam ucyate jñānam.
navabhir indriyaiḥ praptirantyaphalayoḥ | ke punar antye | srotaāpattiphalam arhattvaṃ ca |
dānakṣetraṃ bodhisatvasya buddhakṣetram, tasya bodhiprāptasya sarvaparityāginaḥ satvās tatra buddhakṣetre saṃbhavanti |
svabhāvād yadi bhāvānāṃ sadbhāvam anupaśyasi | ahetupratyayān bhāvāṃs tvam evaṃ sati paśyasi
yatha jambudvīpaka manuṣya alabdhapūrvā divi devauttamapurā anuprāpuṇeyā | paśyitva te viṣaya tatra parigṛhītā punarāgameya na ca niśrayu tatra kuryāt
tad adya māṃ vā naya tatra yatra sa vraja drutaṃ vā punar enam ānaya | ṛte hi tasmān mama nāsti jīvitaṃ vigāḍharogasya sadauṣadhād iva
sudāntānuśayas tyāgī tejasvī śāntamānasaḥ | adīrghasūtro ’capalo niḥsādyo bhava dakṣiṇaḥ
pradīptān śatruvaśagān duḥkhākrāntāṃs tamovṛtān | durgamārgasamārūḍhān mahābandhanasaṃyutān
mātuḥ kukṣī pratisaṃdhikṣaṇe pañca skandhā vijñānam |
idam tu śāstram katham abhidharmakośam |
evaṃ carantu vidu nā pṛthudevasaṃghāḥ kṛtaañjalīpuṭa praṇamya namasyayanti | buddhā pi yāvata daśaddiśi lokadhātau guṇavarṇamālaparikīrtana kurvayanti
tenāmātyānām ājñā dattā | āhūyatāṃ bhavanto jīvaka iti |

tasyāpi vistareṇa jātimahaṃ kṛtvā celeti nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpitam |sā naimittikena dṛṣṭvā vyākṛtā putraṃ janayiṣyati | sa pitaraṃ jīvitād vyaparopya svayam eva paṭṭaṃ baddhvā rājyaṃ kārayiṣyatīti |
tatra katamad bodhisattvasya dharme dharmānupaśyanā smṛtyupasthānam?
tasmāt sadā jāgarikāṃ bhajeta yo vīryavān smṛtimān apramattaḥ | samyojanaṃ jāti jarāṃ ca hitvehaiva duhkhasya karoti so ’ntam
atha ka eṣāṃ hetūnām adhvaniyamaḥ |ukta eṣām arthato ’dhvaniyamaḥ na tu sūtrita ity ataḥ sūtryate |

nāsti kiñcid akliṣṭaṃ darśanaprahātavyaṃ nāpi rūpam |akliṣṭavyākṛtaṃ ca pṛthagjanatvam |samucchinnakuśalamūlavītarāgāṇām api tatsamanvāgamāt rūpaṃ kāyavākkarma |tasmān na darśanaprahātavyam |satyeṣv avipratipatter duḥkhe dharmajñānakṣāntau pṛthagjanatvaprasaṅgāc ca |
paracodanadakṣāṇām anadhīṣṭopakāriṇām | pratīcchec chirasā vākyaṃ sarvaśiṣyaḥ sadā bhavet
duḥkhilatā (duḥkhalīlāduḥkhalitā)
vanād nirvaṇam āgataḥ
tathāgatasya maitrīkaruṇāmuditopekṣā, bhadanta śāradvatīputrākṣayās, tad bodhicittaṃ teṣāṃ mūlam utpādyate, tasmād akṣayam;
bodhicittāsaṃpramoṣeṇa ye ’smin dharmaparyāye ’bhiyuktāḥ śīlavratasaṃvarā, iyaṃ tasya śīlapāramitāparipūriḥ. tat kasya hetoḥ? sarvabodhisattvaśīlaśikṣā asmin dharmaparyāye paridīpitāḥ.
turagāvacaraṃ sa bodhayitvā javinaṃ chandakam ittham ity uvāca | hayam ānaya kanthakaṃ tvarāvān amṛtaṃ prāptum ito ’dya ma yiyāsā
marīcis toyasadṛśī yathā nāmbho na cārthataḥ | skandhās tathātmasadṛśā nātmāno nāpi te ’rthataḥ
agrāhyānabhilapyatvaṃ svaphalānām anudgrahāt | dvayāvaraṇanirmokṣāt subhūtāv araṇādvayaṃ ||
aniṣpannāś ca niṣpannā vijñeyāḥ sarvabhūmayaḥ | niṣpannā apy aniṣpannā niṣpannāś ca punar matāḥ
yāvat punar api dvātriṃśatā goṣṭhikais tasmin stūpe pūjā kṛtā |sā yuvatis tatra sannihitaiva |pūjāṃ kṛtvā praṇidhānaṃ kṛtam |anena vayaṃ kuśalamūlena mahānto ’grabalinaḥ syāma |

sa saṃlakṣayati | dvābhyāṃ kāraṇābhyāṃ gulmo bhidyate |atyantaharṣeṇa vā atyantaroṣeṇa vā | tad ayaṃ pāpakārī satvaḥ | kuto ’syātyantaharṣaḥ | sarvathā roṣayitavya iti viditvā kathayati |deva samayena cikitsāṃ karomi | yady udāyibhadrasya kumārasya māṃsaṃ paribhuṃkṣveti |
pratirūpakaṃ dhūpitakarṇikā vā lohārdhamāṣa iva hiraṇyac channaḥ | caranti haike parivāravantas tv antar hy aśuddhā bahi śobhamānāḥ
sa hi śakyate nidarśayitum idam ihāmutreti | uktaṃ bhavati anidarśanāḥ śeṣā iti ||
na ca vastuniśrayu karoti daditva dānaṃ vidu pāku naiva pratikāṅkṣati so kadācit | evaṃ tyajitva bhavate vidu sarvatyāgī alpaṃ tyajitva labhate bahu aprameyam
nāmarūpamataḥ param prāk ṣaḍāyatanotpādāt
na mama dānaṃ sahāyakam, ahaṃ punar dānasya sahāyah;na mama śīlakṣāntivīryadhyānaprajñāḥ sahāyakā, ahaṃ punaḥ śīlakṣāntivīryadhyānaprajñānāṃ sahāyaḥ;
sarvebhyo darśanādibhyo yadi pūrvo na vidyate | ekaikasmāt kathaṃ pūrvo darśanādeḥ sa vidyate
sarvāvaraṇavivaraṇaparyutthānavigataḥ (sarvāvaraṇaparyutthānaparyupasthānavigataḥ)
atīte ’dhvany asaṅgam apratihataṃ jñānadarśanaṃ pravartate
na kavalacchedakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |

nairmāṇikas tu kāyo buddhānām aprameyaprabhedaṃ buddhanirmāṇaṃ sāṃbhogikaḥ svārthasaṃpattilakṣaṇaḥ | nairmāṇikaḥ parārthasaṃpattilakṣaṇaḥ | evaṃ dvayārthasaṃpattir yathākramaṃ dvayoḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ sāṃbhogike ca kāye nairmāṇike ca |
anuttarapadajñāya sarvāpadapahāriṇe | apadāyānupādāya dvipadāgrāya te namaḥ

avinivartanīyākāraliṅganimittaparivartaḥ saptadaśaḥ |
mama buddhir utpannā | tatra ' pratisandhiṃ gṛhṇāmi yatraitān satvān svakaṃ svakaṃ karmaphalaṃ paribhuñjānān paśyāmīti |
anarthadoṣo daśama āghāto yena vardhate ' taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā pravrajīta āghātena anarthikaḥ ||

śataṃ vibhūtigamānāṃ tallakṣaṇam
ebhis tavopadiṣṭavyaṃ jñātvā kāryaṃ tvayādarāt | anayā nayasaṃpattyā parāṃ siddhim avāpsyasi
sa kathayaty ayaṃ me pitā ayaṃ me bhrātā ayaṃ me pitṛvyo ’yaṃ me mātula iti |

śaikṣamaśaikṣaṃ ceti |

yad artham icchanti dhanāni dehinas tadeva dhīrā visṛjanti dehiṣu | śarīrahetor dhanam iṣyate janais tad eva dhīraiḥ śataśo visṛjyate
samyaksamādhiṃ niśritya citte cittasyāvasthānāt | dharmāṇāṃ ca pravicayād yathākramaṃ śamatho vipaśyanā ca veditavyā | na tu vinā samyaksamādhinety etac chamathavipaśyanālakṣaṇaṃ |
svabhāvaṃ parabhāvaṃ ca bhāvaṃ cābhāvam eva ca | ye paśyanti na paśyanti te tattvaṃ buddhaśāsane
ata eva vicāro ’yaṃ pratipakṣo ’sya bhāvyate | vikalpakṣetrasaṃbhūtadhyānāhārā hi yoginaḥ

so ’pareṇa samayena bhagavatsakāśam upasaṃkrāntaḥ | sa madāvalepena satyāni na paśyati |bhagavān saṃlakṣayati | jīvako vaidyarāja āhṛtakuśalamūlaḥ kimarthaṃ satyāni na paśyati |madāvalepanāt | madāpanayo ’sya kartavya iti |
na tvayā saṃskṛtaḥ kaś cid bhavati brāhmaṇo ’śuciḥ | na copanīto brāhmaṇyāt patati brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ
vināpi darśanādīni yadi cāsau vyavasthitaḥ | amūny api bhaviṣyanti vinā tena na saṃśayaḥ

yānatraye kauśalam etya buddhyā svasyaiva yānasya yateta siddhau |

sarvakāmān viprahāya yo ’nagāraḥ parivrajet | kāmāsravavisamyuktaṃ bravīmi brāhmaṇaṃ hi tam

narakādisvanāmoktā gatayaḥ pañca teṣu

pūrvācaramam api bhikṣavo na jānanti | bhagavān āha | ekaṃ pariṣkāraṃ vikrīya tataḥ stokaṃ saṃghavṛddhāya saṃghanavakāya ca datvā yatheṣṭaṃ bhājayitavyam | nātra kaukṛtyaṃ karaṇīyam |jñaptau ca kṛtāyāṃ pūrvācarame vā mṛtapariṣkāriko lābhaḥ sarvabuddhaśiṣyebhyaḥ prāpadyata iti |
svālambanā susaṃbhārā susaṃstabdhā subhāvanaiva deśitā | suniryāṇaprayogā cātmasamyakpradhānatā
taiḥ samākhyātaṃ jīvatīti |
tatha jñāna śrāvakavimuktisapratyayānāṃ sarvatra bhoti kuśalo vidu bodhisattvo | no cāpi tatra sthihate na ca buddhajñāne na ca saṃskṛte bhavati mārgavidū vidhijño
bhagini tvam evaṃ kathayasi | duṣkuhakā jambudvīpakā manuṣyā nābhiśraddadhāsyanti |
viṣādapāriplavalocanā tataḥ pranaṣṭapotā kurarīva duḥkhitā | vihāya dhairyaṃ virurāva gautamī tatāma caivāśrumukhī jagāda ca
anya utpādayaty enaṃ yady utpādo ’navasthitiḥ | athānutpāda utpannaḥ sarvam utpadyatāṃ tathā
pratyakṣam api rūpādi prasiddhyā na pramāṇataḥ | aśucyādiṣu śucyādiprasiddhir iva sā mṛṣā
śāśvatadṛṣṭigatakudṛṣṭigahanena '
devasya pratipattavyam |
duḥkhamayaṃ saṃsāraṃ yatkṛpayā na tyajati satvārthaṃ | parahitahetor duḥkhaṃ kiṃ kārūṇikair na samupetam
nāvaraṇakārakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā
asya kṣetrasya vijñānāt kṣetrajña iti saṃjñi ca | kṣetrajña iti cātmānaṃ kathayanty ātmacintakāḥ
mahatā ca bodhisattvagaṇena sārdham
ārakṣāṃ pratītya duḥkhaṃ '
śubhe sarvatra pañca ca |
dharme tu ye hy āryanivedite ratās tadā carante vacasā yadāhuḥ | te kṣānti sauratyasamādhi gocarāḥ śrutasya buddher api sāram adhyaguḥ
tasya sahodayāc cittavarasya dhīmataḥ susaṃvṛtaṃ cittam anantaduṣkṛtāt | sukhena duḥkhena ca modate sadā śubhī kṛpāluś ca vivardhanadvayam

arūpiṇaṃ sadā cittam asāram anidarśanam | damayitvā hy abhijñāya ye caranti sadā smṛtāḥ | kṣīṇasamyojanā buddhā lokeṣu brāhmaṇā hi te || arūpam anidarśanam anantam asudarśanam | sūkṣmaṃ padam abhijñāya ye caranti sadā smṛtāḥ | kṣīṇasamyojanā buddhās te loke brāhmaṇā iha
evaṃ dṛṣtir atīte yā nābhūm aham abhūm aham | ubhayaṃ nobhayaṃ ceti naiṣā samupapadyate
śabdagrahaṇarūpaṃ yat tad rūpagrahaṇaṃ katham | ekaḥ pitā ca putraś ca kalpyate na tu tattvataḥ
sa evānabhisaṃskāro dvitīyaṃ phalam iṣyate | kṣetraśuddhiś ca satvānāṃ pākaniṣpattir eva ca
gurutaraṃ bhavati
kālaparīkṣā nāmaikonaviṃśatitamaṃ prakaraṇaṃ ||
tvayy āgate pūrṇa ivāśramo ’bhūt saṃpadyate śūnya iva prayāte | tasmād imaṃ nārhasi tāta hātuṃ jijīviṣor deham iveṣṭam āyuḥ
tiṣṭhaty apy aparaḥ |
jīvitahetor api
yac ca varṣaśataṃ jīved apaśyann udayavyayam | ekāhaṃ jīvitaṃ śreyaḥ paśyato hy udayavyayam
āha: buddhamāhātmye sthātukāmena sarvasatvasamatāyāṃ sthātavyam |

api tu khalu punaḥ subhūte ye kulaputrā vā kuladuhitaro vā imaṃ dharmaparyāyam udgrahīṣyaṃti | dhārayiṣyaṃti | vācayiṣyaṃti | paryavāpsyaṃti | jñātās te subhūte tathāgatena dṛṣṭās te subhūte tathāgatena buddhās te tathāgatena |sarve te satvāḥ aprameyaṃ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyaṃti |
yathāsthānaṃ kramo ’thavā
ya evaṃrūpo dharmprativedhaḥ sārthapratisaṃvit.
idam ucyate, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, bodhisattvānām akṣayaṃ bodhicittam.
ahaṃ nāga iva saṃgrāme cāpād utpatitān śarān | ativākyaṃ titīkṣāmi duhśīlo hi mahājanaḥ
niravadyaṃ śuddhapadaṃ hitāv ahaṃ caiva sānurakṣaṃ ca | nirmṛgyaṃ nirlepaṃ jinātmajānāṃ kṛpādānam
vijñaptimātram evedam ity api hay upalambhataḥ | sthāpayann agrataḥ kiñcit tanmātre nāvatiṣṭhate
tatra katamātyantakṣāntiḥ?
te kathayanty ebhir arhanto jīvitād vyavaropitā mā tvayāpi vyavaropitāḥ
apriyasya me arthaṃ kariṣyaty utpadyate cetasa āghātaḥ |
pramādam anuvartante bālā durmedhaso janāḥ | apramādaṃ tu medhāvī dhanaṃ śreṣṭhī iva rakṣati
madviyogaṃ prati cchanda saṃtāpas tyajyatām ayam | nānābhāvo hi niyataṃ pṛthagjātiṣu dehiṣu
suprabuddhaṃ prabudhyante ime gautama śrāvakāḥ | yeṣāṃ divā ca rātrau caivānimitte rataṃ manaḥ
vyañjanam iti yaḥ śamathavipaśyanāsaṃbhāranirdeśaḥ, artha iti yad vidyāvimuktijñānam.
ālekhyaḥ (ālekhyo, alekho)
tatra vedanāsv anudarśinā viharatā bodhisattvena sarvasattvānāṃ vedanānām utpādasthitibhaṅgajñānam utpādayitavyam.
dvitīyo ’py uktaḥ | sālohita tvaṃ bhājaya |
sa gatas tena nānāvidhā oṣadhayo gṛhītāḥ |bhagavān kathayati | jīvaka kiṃ nāmeyam oṣadhiḥ |
ca(nd)r(a)koṭī kuṭi(lak)ā yal loke vyaktim āgatā | ajihmarucirāṅgābhis tad (da)ṃṣṭrābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tava
ity āryasaddharmapuṇḍarīke dhamaparyāye nidānaparivarto nāma prathamaḥ
buddhapraṇītānuṣṭhānād arvāgasthānacetanāt | taddhānivṛddhyā satveṣu anāmodaḥ pramodanā
asaṃkhyeya parivartaḥ
ahiṃsakaiḥ śubhācārair vratasthair atithipriyaiḥ | sarvakṣamair akalahair bhajyeraṃs taiḥ sadodyataiḥ
sattvaś ca ālayarato viṣayābhilāṣī sthita agrahe abudha yo mahaandhabhūto | dharmo anālayu anāgrahu prāpitavyo lokena sārdha ayu vigrahu prādubhūto
dharmāḥ subhāvitā yasya saptasambhodhapakṣikāḥ | kalyāṇa dharmaṃ āhus taṃ sadā bhikṣuṃ samāhitam
śataṃ ṭiṭilānāṃ vyavasthāna prajñaptir nāmocyate
tat tasya pratibhānaṃ karmavipākapariśodhitaṃ,buddhādhiṣṭhitaṃ,devaparigṛhītam,akṣūṇavyākaraṇam,amoghadharmadeśakaṃ,nirvāṇamārgagamanam;sa evaṃ pratibhānasaṃpanno bhavati.
adhiṣṭhānaguṇair gātram adhiṣṭhātṛguṇair guṇāḥ | parayā saṃpadopetās tavānyonyānurūpayā
antarīkṣa iva raṅgacitraṇā mārutaḥ khagapathāśrito yathā | jñānam evam iha bhāgaśaḥ kṛtaṃ durdṛśaṃ bhagavatām anāsravam
yathā dvayapratibhāsād anyo na dvayalakṣaṇaḥ | iti cittaṃ citrābhāsaṃ citrākāraṃ pravartate
chādyerann api me doṣāḥ syān me pūjāsya no bhavet | sulabdhā adya me lābhāḥ pūjito ’ham ayaṃ na tu
viśākhā kathayati |dhanayauvane hi puruṣāḥ |kiṃ vicāreṇa dīyatām iti |śrīvardhanaḥ kathayati |bhadre asmākaṃ viśākhopakāriṇī | dīyatām |
sukhaṃ jīvitum icchet cet śrāmaṇyārtheṣv avekṣavān | itaretareṇa saṃtuṣyed ekadharmaṃ ca bhāvayet

sā śrutvā kathitā | mayā evaṃ rūpam akṛtyaṃ kṛtaṃ sa cāgataḥ | katham atra pratipattavyam iti |tayā eṣa vṛttānto rājñe niveditaḥ |tato rājñā pratideśo dattaḥ | nirviśaṃkā tiṣṭha | ahaṃ tathā kariṣye yathā na śīghram āgamiṣyatīti |
caturthaṃ daśakam
tat kasya hetoḥ? śrāvakānāṃ samyagdṛṣṭiḥ parato ghoṣānvayā.
na yūyaṃ puṭāpuṭīṃ dhārayata |
saṃprajānan mṛṣāvādāt pāyantikā |
dhik tvām astu jare grāmye virūpa karaṇī hy asi | tathā mano ramaṃ bimbaṃ jarayā hy abhimarditam
krodhopanāhaśāṭhyerṣyāpradāsamrakṣamatsarāḥ | māyāmada vihiṃsāś ca parīttakleśabhūmikāḥ

(bhagnā)su vādidaṃṣ(ṭ)rāsu sātyake sadasi tvayā | patitānīva śṛṅgāni sa(r)v(eṣāṃ para)vād(i)nām
kaṇṭhoktakārikādīnāṃ nāmāni
sāsyāśrayaparāvṛttiḥ prathamā bhūmir iṣyate | ameyaiś cāsya sā kalpaiḥ suviśuddhiṃ nigacchati
aparasyāpy akṣirogaḥ | sa jīvakasakāśaṃ saṃprasthitaḥ |tena brāhmaṇena dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaś ca | bhoḥ puruṣa kva gacchasīti |
na kevalaṃ naiḥṣyandikī kāmarūpārūpyāvacarī |
bhraṣṭasya tasmāc ca guṇād ato me dhyānāni labdhvāpy akṛtārthataiva | dharmasya tasyā śravaṇād ahaṃ hi manye vipattiṃ tridive ’pi vāsam
sa kathayati | kīdṛśāni mama bhaiṣajyānīti |
labhyaṃ bhadanta kauśeyaṃ cīvaraṃ tricīvarādhiṣṭhānena atirekacīvarādhiṣṭhānena dhārayitum |
punar aparaṃ dānaṃ ya āśayatas tyāgaḥ;priyavāditā yaḥ prayogāparicchedaḥ;arthacaryā yādhyāśayena dattvākaukṛtyatā;samānārthatā yā mahāyānapariṇāmanā.
sa kathayati | bhavanto yuṣmākaṃ dīrgharātram ayam āśvāsakaḥ | aho bata khaṇḍaḥ kālaṃ kuryān niṣpalāyeta iti vā iti | sa yuṣmākam alpakṛcchreṇa paripūrṇaḥ | gacchata niṣpalāyaty ayam iti |
evaṃ bhadanta ity āyuṣmān ānando bhagavataḥ pratiśrutya yena rājā prasenajit kosalas tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ | upasaṃkramya yathāsandiṣṭaṃ niveditavān | rājā kathayati |

dhyānaṃ buddhasutaiḥ samādhibahulaṃ saṃpāditaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhair dhyānasukhair vihṛtya kṛpayā hīnāpapattiḥ śritā | dhyānenaiva ca tena sarvajanatā bodhitraye ropitā dhyānaṃ jñānaparigraheṇa ca punar loke ’kṣayaṃ sthāpitam
na viparyasyamānasya saṃbhavanti viparyayāḥ | vimṛśasva svayaṃ kasya saṃbhavanti viparyayāḥ

yathā hastacchinnaka evaṃ pādacchinnakāḥ aṅgulīphaṇahastakāḥ anoṣṭhā lakṣaṇāhatāḥ kaśāhatāḥ citrāṅgāḥ ativṛddhāś ca na pravrājayitavyāḥ atibālāṃ pravrājayanti te sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanam uccāraprasrāveṇa nāśayanti |
yathāgāraṃ succhannaṃ vṛṣṭir na vyatibhindati | evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ dveṣo na vyatibhindati
nājātasya hi jātena phalasya saha hetunā | nājātena na naṣṭena saṃgatir jātu vidyate
sūtra uktaṃ “sapta bhavāḥ |narakabhavas tiryagbhavaḥ pretabhavo devabhavo manuṣyabhavaḥ karmabhavo ’ntarābhava iti |naitat sūtraṃ tair āmnāyate | itas tarhi
asmin prakaraṇe
na vyāyameta sarvatra nānyeṣāṃ puruṣo bhavet | nānyāṃ nihśritya jīveta dharmeṇa na vaṇik caret

tasya cet kāmayānasya cchandajātasya dehinaḥ | te kāmā na samṛdhyanti śalyaviddha iva rūpyate ||
kiṃ śrāmaṇerikāyāḥ karaṇīyaṃ. etad eva sarvaṃ śrāmaṇerikāyāḥ karaṇīyaṃ.
utthānakāleṣu nihīnavīryo vācā balī tv ālasiko nirāśaḥ | sadaiva saṃkalpahataḥ kusīdo jñānasya mārgaṃ satataṃ na vetti
pare ’pakāriṇyupakāribuddhimān pramarṣayann ugram api vyatikramam | upāyacittair apakāramarṣaṇaiḥ śubhe samādāpayate ’pakāriṇaḥ
bhagavān āha | tīrthikadhvaja eṣa mohapuruṣa pūrvavad yāvat sātisāro bhavati |

kvaciddharmāñ ca kaṃ dharmyaṃ cakraṃ bahumukhaśatair darśayati yaḥ kvacij janmāntardhiṃ kvacid api vicitrāṃ janacarīm | kvacitkṛtsnāṃ bodhiṃ kvacid api ca nirvāṇam asakṛt na ca sthānāt tasmād vicalati sa sarvaṃ ca kurute
puṇyajñānasupūrṇatvāt pūrṇacandropamā matā | jñānālokakaratvāc ca mahādityopamā matā
heṭhāpahaṃ hy uttamabodhibījaṃ sukhāvahaṃ tāyapakam iṣṭahetuṃ | svabhāvadaṃ dharmam upāśritasya bodhir na dūre jinātmajasya

uktā vimalā buddhaguṇāḥ | tat karma jinakriyedānīṃ vaktavyā | sā punar anābhogataś cāpraśrabdhitaś ca samāsato dvābhyām ākārābhyāṃ pravartata iti | anantaram anābhogāpraśrabdhaṃ buddhakāryam ārabhya dvau ślokau |

tasmāt tarhi bho jinaputra, prabhāṣasva | tathāgatā eva arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhā ārakṣām adhiṣṭhāsyanti ||
parārthaikāntakalyāṇī kāmaṃ svāśrayaniṣṭhurā | tvayy eva kevalaṃ nātha karuṇākaruṇābhavat
puṇye tu kṛte hi nandate cirakṛte dūrakṛte ’pi nandate | rahasi ca kṛte ’pi nandate bhūyo nandati sadgatiṃ gataḥ

tam enam ahaṃ jānāmi śakra eṣa deavendra iti |tam aham etad avocam:svāgataṃ te kauśika, apramattena te bhavitavyaṃ sarvakāmaratiṣu,anityapratyavekṣanābahulenāttasāreṇa te bhavitavyaṃ kāyajīvitabhogebhyaḥ |

rājñā tasya dūto ’nupreṣitaḥ | sārthavāha mamāmukenāmukena ca ratnena prayojanam | tena vinā tvayā iha na praveṣṭavyam iti |sa teṣāṃ ratnānām arthāya dūrataraṃ praviṣṭaḥ |
uktaṃ bhagavatā adyāgreṇa bhikṣubhir niṣadyā kriyā poṣadhaś ca pratijāgartavya iti | te na jānanti kā niṣadyā kā kriyā kaḥ poṣadha iti | etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti |
sādhu sādhu viśākhe etad api gatam |kimarthavaśaṃ samanupaśyantī saṃghe dhruvayavāguṃ dadāsi |

anādimadhyanidhānaprakṛtatvād asaṃskṛtam | śāntadharmaśarīratvād anābhogam iti smṛtam pratyātmam adhigamyatvād aparapratyayodayam | jñānam evaṃ tridhā bodhāt karuṇāmārgadeśanāt śaktir jñānakṛpābhyāṃ tu duḥkhakleśanibarhaṇāt | tribhir ādyair guṇaiḥ svārthaḥ parārthaḥ paścimais tribhiḥ

akliṣṭāvyākṛtā ’prāptiḥ
ihaiva yaḥ prajānāti duhkhasya kṣayaṃ ātmanaḥ | kalyāṇaprajñaṃ āhus taṃ sadā śīlam anāsravam
dhṛtisaṃgrahapaktivyūhanakarmasv ete yathākramaṃ saṃsiddhāḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyudhātavaḥ |vyūhanaṃ punar vṛddhiḥ prasarpaṇaṃ ca veditavyam |idam eṣāṃ karma | svabhāvas tu yathākramaṃ
buddho ’pi saṃsared evaṃ tataḥ kiṃ bodhicaryayā | pratyayānām anucchede māyāpy ucchidyate na hi
ratanārthiko yatha vrajitvana ratnadvīpaṃ labdhvāna ratna puna geham upāgameyyā | kiṃcāpi tatra sukha jīvati sārthavāho api duḥkhito manasi bhoti sa jātisaṃgho
daśabhyo ’kuśalaṃ
na anāgate ālope mukhadvāraṃ vivariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
tathāpi pracālayanti |bhagavān āha | yaṣṭiḥ sārayitavyā |
na pādukārūḍhāya āglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
pūrvam eva ca sāmagryāḥ phalaṃ prādurbhaved yadi | hetupratyayanirmuktaṃ phalam āhetukaṃ bhavet
katy upāttāḥ katy anupāttāḥ |

ekatvakāyā ekatvasaṃjñinas tadyathā devāḥ śubhakṛtsnāḥ
yatpratyayā ca tatrāsthā mahāyāne ’pi tāṃ kuru | anyobhayeṣṭasatyatve vedāder api satyatā
nāmādhiṣṭhāna puna māra upāgamitvā evaṃ vadiṣyati idaṃ tava nāmadheyam | mātāpitāya anusaptamupaiti vaṃśo buddho yadā bhavi idaṃ tava nāmadheyam

tatra katamad dharmadānam?yathāśrutadharmāṇām deśanā;priyavāditā yā nirāmiṣeṇa cittena dharmasya saṃprakāśanā;arthacaryā yā paropadeśe svādhyāyāvatāre ’parikhedatā;samānārthatā yaḥ sarvajñatācittāviyuktatayā dharmalābhaḥ pareṣāṃ cāvatāraṇatā.
mṛgāreṇa amātyānāṃ niveditam | tair api yathā samādiṣṭā parīkṣā kṛtā |tataḥ prabhātāyāṃ rajanyāṃ rājñe niveditam |deva iyaṃ mātā iyaṃ duhitā iti |

dāne sannān iti saṃbandhanīyaṃ | ṣaḍbhir guṇair dāne ’vasannān bodhisatvānkaruṇā protsahayatīva | svabhāvavṛddhyā | bhogais tadvardhanayā | dānena satvaparipācanayā | dātuś ca sukhotpādanāt | mahābodhisaṃbhārasyānyasyākarṣaṇāt | mahābodhisamīpanayanāc ca | parasaukhyena sukhābhave ślokaḥ |
duḥkhahetur ahaṃkāra ātmamohāt tu vardhate | tato ’pi na nivartyaś cet varaṃ nairātmyabhāvanā
anekavidham ṛddhiviṣayaṃ pratyanubhavati
ime, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, bodhisattvānām akṣayāṇi dharmoddānāni.
āsvādanīyo ghoṣeṇa
vinā gandharasaghrāṇajihvāvijñānadhātubhiḥ
sukhaṃ buddhasya cotpādaḥ sukhaṃ dharmasya deśanā | sukhaṃ saṃghasya sāmagrī samagrāṇāṃ tapaḥ sukham
yac ca varṣaśataṃ jīved apaśyann acalaṃ padam | ekāhaṃ jīvitaṃ śreyaḥ paśyato hy acalaṃ padam

kṛcchralabdhān apy asārān kṣayitvā prāṇān bhogāṃś ca bodhisatvā duḥkhitebhyaḥ kāruṇyāt satatam udārair visargair utsṛjanti prāg eva dharmaṃ yo naiva kṛcchreṇa vā bhṛśam api vāvasṛjatāṃ vṛddhiṃ gachati na kṣayaṃ | dharmanairarthakyasārthakye ślokadvayaṃ |
punar aparaṃ, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, bodhisattvānāṃ saptabodhyaṅgāny apy akṣayāṇi.
bodhicaryāvatāre bodhicittaparigraho nāma tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ ||
naiva bhavati na na bhavatitathāgataḥ paraṃ maraṇāt(maraṇataḥ)

atha khalv āyuṣmāñ śāradvatīputro ’kṣayamatiṃ bodhisattvam idam avocat: subhāṣitā tvayeyaṃ, kulaputra, bodhisattvānāṃ dānākṣayatā. pratibhātu te, kulaputra, bodhisattvānāṃ śīlākṣayatām ārabhya, yathā bodhisattvānāṃ śīlam akṣayaṃ bhavet.
yāvaj jīvaṃ pi cet bālaḥ paṇḍitān paryupāsate | na sa dharmaṃ vijānāti samyaksambuddhadeśitam
sa kiṃ saṃskriyate yatnād ātmaghātāya śastravat | ātmavyāmohanodyuktair unmattair ākulā mahī
tasya śrutvābhimāno jātaḥ | sa āyuṣmata ānandasya sakāśam upasaṃkrāntaḥ | upasaṃkramyāyuṣmantam ānandaṃ pṛcchati |

kleśajñeyavṛtīnāṃ satatam anugataṃ bījam utkṛṣṭakālaṃ yasminn astaṃ prayātaṃ bhavati suvipulaiḥ sarvahāniprakāraiḥ | buddhatvaṃ śukladharmapravaraguṇayutā āśrayasyānyathāptis tatprāptir nirvikalpād viṣayasumahato jñānamārgāt suśuddhāt
adaridraṃ jagat kṛtvā dānapāramitā yadi | jagaddaridram adyāpi sā kathaṃ pūrvatāyinām
parinirvṛtasya tasyaiva maitreyasya mahāmuneḥ | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi saddharmaḥ sthāsyate tadā
kṛpaṇakṛpā raudrakṛpā saṃkṣubdhakṛpā kṛpā pramatteṣu | viṣayaparatantrakaruṇā mithyābhiniviṣṭakaruṇā ca
dṛṣṭaśrutādyaṃ muninā na satyaṃ na mṛṣoditam | pakṣād dhi pratipakṣaḥ syād ubhayaṃ tac ca nārthataḥ

ahaṃ cet trivācikayā pravāraṇayā pravārayeyaṃ, syān me atonidānaṃ jīvitāntarāyaḥ śrāmaṇyāntarāyo brahmacaryāntarāyaḥ. yanv aham ekavācikayā pravāraṇayā pravārayeyaṃ. sa ekavācikayā pravāraṇayā pravārayati. asminn arthe ekavācikā pravāraṇā |
atha loleksaṇā kācij jighrantī nīlam utpalam | kiṃcinmadakalair vākyair nṛpātmajam abhāṣata
atha te pramāṇasiddhyā prameyasiddhiḥ prameyasiddhyā ca | bhavati pramāṇasiddhir nāsty ubhayasyāpite siddhiḥ
rūpakāraṇanirmuktaṃ na rūpam upalabhyate | rūpeṇāpi na nirmuktaṃ dṛśyate rūpakāraṇam
na śivikārūḍhāya āglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
(varṇārhavarṇe) buddhastotre vāgviśuddhir nāma pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ
agnyarthī vādharāraṇyāṃ sātatye pratipadyate | vaiśvāsiko vāniṣpanne adhicitte prapadyate
sa gāthāṃ bhāṣate | vṛkṣasya patanakāle śākhāpattrāṇi kim uta
apalālo nāgarājā
satvānāṃ paripākaś ca svacittasya ca rakṣaṇā | dhīmadbhir jīyate duḥkhaṃ durjayā tena kathyate
yaivaṃrūpā vyākhyā deśanā prakāśanedam ucyate bodhisattvasya pratyekabuddhayānakauśalyam.
marīcyupamo ’yaṃ kāyaḥ kleśatṛṣṇāsaṃbhūtaḥ |
āha: kuśalasyākuśalasya ca kiṃ mūlam |
pravṛtter āśrayotpattisthitipratyupabhogataḥ | caturdaśa tathā ’nyāni nivṛtterindriyāṇi vā

aparasminn arthe ekavācikā pravāraṇā. yathāpi tad vihāraḥ anūpamadhye pratiṣṭhāpito bhavati | upari parvatasaṃkṣepe sthūlabinduko devo varṣaṃ grāmanigamarājarāṣṭradhānīṃ vahaṃ paraiti. gocaram api vahati | gocaramārgam api caṃkramam api meḍhīm api dvārakoṣṭhakam api. vihāram api saṃsvedayati.
yo evaśīlasamanvāgatu niṣprapañco anapekṣako bhavati sarvapriyāpriyeṣu | śirahastapāda tyajamāna adīnacitto sarvāstityāgi bhavate satataṃ alīno
bhūyo mahānidhānavadanyo ratnākaro yathaivānyaḥ | sāgarasadṛśo jñeyo vajraprakhyo ’calendranibhaḥ
sopasṛṣṭāmbaravasanā kleśair bādhitum ārabdhā |rājā bimbisāro hastiskandhābhirūḍhas tasyā gṛhasamīpena gacchati |tayā ca vātāyanasthayā rājñaḥ sragdāmaṃ kṣiptam |
upasaṃkramī lokavināyakeṣu pṛcchanti dharmaṃ pravaraṃ śivāya | kāṣāyavastrāṇi ca prāvaranti keśāṃś ca śmaśrūṇy avatārayanti
āha: anutpādānirodhaprayukto yoniśaḥ prayukto bhavati |
bhiksuṇīsārthena saha gamanam
tato ’vasāne pariṇāmitaṃ | yānīha bhūtāni samāgatāni sthitāni bhūmāv athavāntarikṣe || kurvantu maitrīṃ satataṃ prajāsu divā ca rātrau ca carantu dharmam iti ||
na ca kīrtikāma na ca krodhaparītacittā gṛhibhūta nitya anadhyoṣita sarva vastuṃ | na ca jīvikāviṣayabhoga gaveṣayanti abhicāramantra na ca istriprayogamantrāḥ
nindanty alābhinaṃ sattvam avadhyāyanti lābhinam | prakṛtyā duḥkhasaṃvāsaiḥ kathaṃ tair jāyate ratiḥ
atha khalu bhagavān imam evārthaṃ bhūyasyā mātrayā saṃdarśayamānas tasyāṃ velāyām imā gāthā abhāṣata ||
tatra dharme jugupsī akṣāntijugupsanāt | dharme vaśī samāpattau | dharmapradhāno mahābodhiparamaḥ | dharma evātra dharama ukto vṛttānuvṛttyā | śeṣaṃ gatārthaṃ |
tatra katamā pravṛttiḥ? yā kāyālaṃkāratā. tatra katamā sthitiḥ? yā kāyadharmatā.
yo niścayo hy asya parākramaś ca tejaś ca yad yā ca dayā prajāsu | aprāpya notthāsyati tattvam eṣa tamāṃsy ahatveva sahasraraśmiḥ
na jaṭābhir na gotreṇa na jātyā brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | yasya satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca sa śucir brāhmaṇaḥ sa ca
sa ṣaḍvargikair dṛṣṭaḥ | te kathayanti | āyuṣmanto vinā vāditreṇa bhikṣur nṛtyati | vāditraṃ vādayateti | te mukhavāditraṃ vādayitum ārabdhāḥ |
śūnyatā ca na cocchedaḥ saṃsāraś ca na śāśvatam | karmaṇo ’vipraṇāśaś ca dharmo buddhena deśitaḥ
punaḥ saivāṅgasākalyāj jagatī dvādaśākṣaraiḥ | pādaiḥ satyanayenaiva pūrvavat parivartitā
āpattivyutthānam (utpatts)
utpādādyās trayo vyastā nālaṃ lakṣaṇakarmaṇi | saṃskṛtasya samastāḥ syur ekatra katham ekadā
namaḥ suragaṇayakṣa kiṃnarasevite | ābaddhamuditābhoga kaliduḥsvapnanāśini
yantrabhūto bata ayaṃ kāyo ’sthisnāyuvinibaddhaḥ |
catvāry adhiṣṭhānāni
pṛthaktve sahabhāvaś ca yadi kiṃ rāgaraktayoḥ | siddhaḥ pṛthakpṛthagbhāvaḥ sahabhāvo yatas tayoḥ
dhanyaiḥ śaśāṅkakaracandanaśītaleṣu ramyeṣu harmyavipuleṣu śilātaleṣu | niḥśabdasaumyavanamārutavījyamānaiḥ caṅkramyate parahitāya vicintyate ca
rājā bimbisāro ’tīva paradārābhirataḥ |upaiti hastiskandhābhirūḍho nagare rathyāḥ | ālolekṣaṇo ’nvāhiṇḍate |
anuttaraṃ vā yogakṣemaṃ nirvāṇam anuprāpsyāmīti saṃpaśyatā paṇḍitena alam eva pravrajyādhimuktena bhavituṃ |
bahūnām ekaduḥkhena yadi duḥkhaṃ vigacchati | utpādyam eva tadduḥkhaṃ sadayena parātmanoḥ
jāyate ’syā vipākena tuṣitālayadevarāṭ | sarvatīrthakarakleśadṛṣṭisthānanivartakaḥ
prakṣiptaś ca bhaye ’py ātmā draviṇaṃ ca vyayīkṛtam | yāny eva ca pariṣvajya babhūvottamanirvṛtiḥ
ātmaiva hy ātmano nāthaḥ ātmā śaraṇaṃ ātmanaḥ | tasmāt samyamayātmānaṃ bhadrāśvam iva sārathiḥ
iṣṭaṃ hi tarṣapraśamāya toyaṃ kṣunnāśahetor aśanaṃ tathaiva | vātātapāmbvāvaraṇāya veśma kaupīnaśītāvaraṇāya vāsaḥ
na kartavyaṃ bhavet kiṃcid anārabdhā bhavet kriyā | kārakaḥ syād akurvāṇaḥ śūnyatāṃ pratibādhataḥ
tasmāt svapne sute naṣṭe so nāstīti vikalpanā | tadbhāvakalpanotpādaṃ vibadhnāti mṛṣā ca sā
darśanādau ca tadyatnaḥ svayaṃbhūr na trayād api | tadyatnapratyayatvaṃ ca niryatnaṃ darśanādikaṃ
saṃbahulā śaikṣadharmāḥ
punar aparaṃ, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, bodhisattvānāṃ catvāri dharmoddānāny apy akṣayāṇi.
parīttakleśā bhūmir eṣāṃ ta ime parīttakleśabhūmikā avidyāmātreṇa bhāvanāheyena manobhūmikenaiva ca saṃprayogāt |eṣāṃ tu nirdekśa upakleśeṣu kariṣyate |
uttīrṇo yena vai paṅko marditā grāma kaṇṭakāḥ | yaś ca mohakṣayaṃ prāptaḥ sa vai bhikṣur nirucyate
suvipulaguṇabodhivṛkṣavṛddhyai dhanasukhaduḥkhaśamopalabdhaye ca | svaparahitasukhakriyāphalatvād bhavati samudagrasamūlam udagragotram etat
atha śroṇaḥ koṭīkarṇaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalasvastyayanaḥ śakaṭair bhārair moṭaiḥ piṭakair uṣṭrair gobhir gardabhaiḥ prabhūtaṃ samudragamanīyaṃ paṇyam āropya mahāsamudraṃ saṃprasthitaḥ |
āstāṃ bhaviṣyad buddhatvaṃ sattvārādhanasaṃbhavam | ihaiva saubhāgyayaśaḥ sausthityaṃ kiṃ na paśyasi
evam eva vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskāravijñānaṃ.
